answers.q1: pnpm (the repo pins pnpm@12.9.1 via packageManager, and the preinstall script runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, so npm and yarn are rejected). Install with: `pnpm install`. Node must be ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Build with `pnpm run build`; CI builds before testing.
answers.q2: `pnpm run build && pnpm test`. The `test` script runs `pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`. CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, so the full CI set is: `pnpm run build && pnpm run test-unit && pnpm run test-serve && pnpm run test-serve-bundled && pnpm run test-build`. The e2e playground tests need Chromium, which you install once with `pnpm playwright install chromium`.
answers.q3: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`. This uses the root vitest.config.ts, which is the unit-test config and the same one `pnpm test-unit` uses. If the repo hasn't been built yet, run `pnpm run build` first.
answers.q4: CI's lint job runs these from the root: `pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test-docs`. `pnpm run lint` is `eslint --cache . --concurrency auto`. `pnpm format` is `oxfmt`, which rewrites files in place, and `git diff --exit-code` then fails if anything changed. The repo isn't currently a git repository, so that last check only works inside a git checkout. The typecheck and docs-build steps are also part of the CI lint job.
answers.q5: Generated or vendored, do not hand-edit: `pnpm-lock.yaml` (generated by pnpm); `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` (generated from commit messages, and excluded from oxfmt); every `dist/` and `dist-ssr/` directory (build output); `node_modules/`; `packages/vite/LICENSE` (generated at build time and gitignored); `playground-temp/` and `temp/` (test scratch copies); `docs/.vitepress/cache` and `docs/.vitepress/.temp` (build caches); `.eslintcache`. Vendored third-party files that the oxfmt config ignores: `playground/external/public/slash@3.0.0.js` and `playground/ssr-html/public/slash@3.0.0.js`. I did not confirm that every file under `packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts` is hand-written; they look like type shims.

q3.reason: `pnpm exec vitest run <file>` from the root is an accepted command.
